protocol.calibration: Select thresholds only from earlier-phase calibration confidence breakpoints, maximizing balanced known-source coverage and unsupported rejection; no finite-sample generalization guarantee.
protocol.cost_contract: Actual source/index/model/optimizer/checkpoint bytes, fit wall/CPU, presentations, feature time, calibration and read time, selected-cell reads, all failed and successful candidate work. Shared resources and candidate exploration are separately visible; no equal-FLOPs claim.
protocol.diagnostics: Training/canonical ranks, ridge affine positive control lambda 0.001, and nearest canonical prototype. No held targets select diagnostics or hyperparameters.
protocol.integrity: The runner writes a local protocol/corpus/source commitment before model fitting, rejects existing output directories, and stores all predictions and selection decisions. No test result selects a threshold, hyperparameter, or topology.
protocol.interpretation: Same-corpus method development after disclosed BCE failures; not independent confirmation.
protocol.scope: Executable research on real technical-document sections with authored prompts; no claim of production tasks, pretrained semantics, native activation, or parametric content compression.

structure.validation_status: Exploratory paired normal bounds on authored tasks; no population or sequential-testing guarantee. All candidate selection precedes the next-phase test.

time_contract.meaning: Document-arrival curriculum, not historical production chronology.
time_contract.phase_0: Initialization: phase-0 sources and train prompts; calibration separate; phase-0 test is an in-phase diagnostic.
time_contract.phase_1_2: Current sources arrive before maintenance; only earlier-phase query labels train the learner or router. Calibration comes from earlier phases. The new phase test is evaluated once after selection; its labels become available only for later phases.

protocol.training_change: Normalize each nonempty source-target row; stable softmax cross entropy. Empty target rows are excluded from categorical fitting, not mislabelled as source distributions; past negative calibration remains shared.
